title: A Space Mega 2
description: A Space Mega II is a modern high-rise condominium located in Mega City Bangna on a land area of 3-2-0 Rai (approximately 1,400 sq.wah). The project offers 998 residential units along with 2 lifestyle shop units, designed to support convenient urban living. Residents can enjoy a wide range of facilities including Co-Living Space, Co-Kitchen Space, 1000 Mb free Wi-Fi, swimming pool, jogging track, meeting room, sky park, fitness center, and EV charging stations, with 272 parking spaces available. The condominium is surrounded by major lifestyle destinations such as IKEA Bangna, Mega Bangna Shopping Mall, Lotus’s Bangna-Trad, Big C Bangna, and Thai Watsadu Bangna, as well as leading schools like Rajavinit Bangkaew School, D-PREP International School, and Concordian International School, and is conveniently located near Suvarnabhumi Airport, making it ideal for comfortable and connected city living. 🏙️✨
payment:
1.Quotation Validity: This quotation is valid for 7 days.

100,000 THB For Two Bedroom
